newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen rising on shipping, warrants.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen rising on shipping, warrants.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to open higher on Monday with shipping shares likely leading the gain following an agreement between Taiwan and Hong Kong to con 1953066613
On Saturday, the weighted index finished 34.32 points or 0.42 percent higher to 8,178.70.
Taiwan and Hong Kong negotiators on Saturday signed a memorandum which would allow their ships to enter each other's ports after the July 1 handover of the British colony to China.
"The agreement is likely to give a boost to shipping shares," said Ben Lee, an senior analyst of Nomura Securities.
